depth_cycle_start_hint: Notice the starting height. With leaning, the next push begins before the chest has returned to the resting line.
depth_cycle_down_hint: The chest is moving toward its deepest point. Follow the downward arrow and the marker on the graph.
depth_cycle_peak_hint: This is the peak depth. You still need to inspect the release to see whether the chest fully recoils.
depth_cycle_up_hint: The chest is returning upward. Compare 25% and 75%: the same height can occur during pressing and releasing.
depth_cycle_full_hint: The chest meets the resting line. Add leaning and return to this point to see what changes.
depth_cycle_lean_hint: The chest remains below the resting line. Reaching the same peak depth did not guarantee full recoil.
depth_cycle_intro: Choose a moment to freeze the manikin and its graph. The blue arrow shows the direction of chest movement.
depth_cycle_help: Drag or use arrow keys. Home returns to the start; End goes to the release.
depth_cycle_depression: Chest depression at this position: {depth} cm.
depth_cycle_pause_hint: Choose a stage or move the slider to inspect a still position. Reduced-motion mode holds the released position.
depth_cycle_graph_cursor: Outlined marker: {phase}% of the cycle · {depth} cm depressed.
depth_cycle_graph_whole: The curve shows one whole cycle. Select a still position to place a marker.
